summary: The Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act of 2025 amends Title IX to prohibit federally funded educational athletic programs from allowing individuals whose biological sex at birth was male to participate in programs designated for women or girls.

affected_groups.effect: Must ensure that athletic programs or activities designated for women or girls do not permit individuals of the male sex to participate, to maintain compliance with Title IX.
affected_groups.group: Federally funded education programs and activities

affected_groups.effect: Participation in athletic programs designated for women or girls is restricted based strictly on reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
affected_groups.group: Individuals participating in school athletic programs

key_provisions: Prohibits school athletic programs from allowing individuals whose biological sex at birth was male to participate in women's or girls' athletic programs.
Establishes that allowing a person of the male sex to participate in programs designated for women or girls violates Title IX of the Education Amendments of 1972.
Defines sex for these athletic compliance purposes as being based solely on a person's reproductive biology and genetics at birth.
missing_information: Specific penalties or enforcement mechanisms for educational institutions that violate the rule.
Details on how compliance or biological sex will be verified or documented.
summary_detail.plain_summary: The Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act of 2025 amends Title IX to prohibit federally funded educational athletic programs from allowing individuals whose biological sex at birth was male to participate in programs designated for women or girls.
summary_detail.significance: This bill changes how Title IX rules apply to school sports by creating a strict federal definition of sex based on birth biology, affecting eligibility for athletic programs across federally funded institutions.

title: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act of 2025
